arxiv-2012-09457.title: Cooperative coinfection dynamics on clustered networks
arxiv-2012-09457.creator: Peter Mann, V. Anne Smith, John B.O. Mitchell, Simon Dobson
arxiv-2012-09457.description: Abstract Coinfection is the process by which a host that is infected with a pathogen becomes infected by a second pathogen at a later point in time. An immunosuppressant host response to a primary disease can facilitate spreading of a subsequent emergent pathogen among the population.

arxiv-2106-06928.title: Fragile topology in nodal-line semimetal superconductors
arxiv-2106-06928.creator: Xiaoming Wang 1, Tao Zhou 1,2
arxiv-2106-06928.description: Abstract We study the band topology of the superconducting nodal-line semimetal (SC-NLSM) protected by the inversion symmetry with and without the spin-orbital coupling. Without the spin-orbital coupling, both the s s -wave SC-NLSM and the chiral p p -wave SC-NLSM are topologically nontrivial and can be described by the nonzero winding number.

arxiv-2404-06390.title: Latent Distance Guided Alignment Training for Large Language Models
arxiv-2404-06390.creator: Haotian Luo
arxiv-2404-06390.description: Abstract Ensuring alignment with human preferences is a crucial characteristic of large language models (LLMs). Presently, the primary alignment methods, RLHF and DPO, require extensive human annotation, which is expensive despite their efficacy. The significant expenses associated with current alignment techniques motivate researchers to investigate the development of annotation-free alignment training methods.

arxiv-2506-08513.title: Designing lensless imaging systems to maximize information capture Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2506-08513.creator: Leyla A. Kabuli, 1,* Henry Pinkard, 1 Eric Markley, 2 Clara S. Hung, 1 and Laura Waller 1
arxiv-2506-08513.description: Abstract Mask-based lensless imaging uses an optical encoder (e.g. a phase or amplitude mask) to capture measurements, then a computational decoding algorithm to reconstruct images. In this work, we evaluate and design encoders based on the information content of their measurements using mutual information estimation.

arxiv-2511-06797.title: FedNET: Federated Learning for Proactive Traffic Management and Network Capacity Planning
arxiv-2511-06797.creator: Saroj Kumar Panda, Basabdatta Palit, and Sadananda Behera
arxiv-2511-06797.description: Abstract We propose FedNET , a proactive and privacy-preserving framework for early identification of high-risk links in large-scale communication networks, that leverages a distributed multi-step traffic forecasting method. FedNET employs Federated Learning (FL) to model the temporal evolution of node-level traffic in a distributed manner, enabling accurate multi-step-ahead predictions (e.g., several hours to days) without exposing sensitive network data.

pmc-10475455.title: Synthesis and clinical application of new drugs approved by FDA in 2022
pmc-10475455.creator: Jing-Yi Zhang, Ya-Tao Wang, Lu Sun, Sai-Qi Wang, Zhe-Sheng Chen
pmc-10475455.description: The pharmaceutical industry had a glorious year in 2022, with a total of 37 new drugs including 20 new chemical entities (NCEs) and 17 new biological entities (NBEs) approved by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA). These drugs are mainly concentrated in oncology, central nervous system, antiinfection, hematology, cardiomyopathy, dermatology, digestive system, ophthalmology, MRI enhancer and other therapeutic fields.

pmc-10514336.title: Olive oil-derived endocannabinoid-like mediators inhibit palatable food-induced reward and obesity
pmc-10514336.creator: Nicola Forte, Charlène Roussel, Brenda Marfella, Anna Lauritano, Rosaria Villano, Elvira De Leonibus, Emanuela Salviati, Tina Khalilzadehsabet, Giada Giorgini, Cristoforo Silvestri, Fabiana Piscitelli, Maria Pina Mollica, Vincenzo Di Marzo, Luigia Cristino
pmc-10514336.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). N-oleoylglycine (OlGly), a lipid derived from the basic component of olive oil, oleic acid, and N-oleoylalanine (OlAla) are endocannabinoid-like mediators. We report that OlGly and OlAla, by activating the peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor alpha (PPARα), reduce the rewarding properties of a highly palatable food, dopamine neuron firing in the ventral tegmental area, and the obesogenic effect of a high-fat diet rich in lard (HFD-L).

pmc-10698175.title: Porcine milk exosomes modulate the immune functions of CD14+ monocytes in vitro
pmc-10698175.creator: Gabriela Ávila Morales, Daria De Leonardis, Joel Filipe, Rafaela Furioso Ferreira, Alessandro Agazzi, Helga Sauerwein, Marcello Comi, Vladimir Mrljak, Cristina Lecchi, Fabrizio Ceciliani
pmc-10698175.description: Exosomes mediate near and long-distance intercellular communication by transferring their molecular cargo to recipient cells, altering their biological response. Milk exosomes (MEx) are internalized by immune cells and exert immunomodulatory functions in vitro. Porcine MEx can accumulate in the small intestine, rich in macrophages.

pmc-10731267.title: Host plant-mediated effects on Buchnera symbiont: implications for biological characteristics and nutritional metabolism of pea aphids (Acyrthosiphon pisum)
pmc-10731267.creator: Hui-ping Liu, Qiao-yan Yang, Jing-xing Liu, Inzamam Ul Haq, Yan Li, Qiang-yan Zhang, Kotb A. Attia, Asmaa M. Abushady, Chang-zhong Liu, Ning Lv
pmc-10731267.description: IntroductionThe pea aphid, Acyrthosiphon pisum, is a typical sap-feeding insect and an important worldwide pest. There is a primary symbiont-Buchnera aphidicola, which can synthesize and provide some essential nutrients for its host. At the same time, the hosts also can actively adjust the density of bacterial symbiosis to cope with the changes in environmental and physiological factors.

pmc-10772460.title: Strategies for mitigating adverse events related to selective RET inhibitors in patients with RET-altered cancers
pmc-10772460.creator: Mirella Nardo, Mohamed A. Gouda, Blessie E. Nelson, Carmelia M.N. Barreto, J. Hoyt Slade, Anna Poullard, Mark Zafereo, Mimi I. Hu, Maria E. Cabanillas, Vivek Subbiah
pmc-10772460.description: SummaryThe US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval of the selective RET inhibitors selpercatinib and pralsetinib has led to a paradigm change in the treatment of RET-altered lung and thyroid cancers through a higher response rate and a more tolerable safety and toxicity profile than multi-kinase inhibitors.

pmc-11507427.title: Missed Insights for Earlier Management of Parkinson’s Disease and the Value of Dopamine Transporter (DAT) Scans
pmc-11507427.creator: Mohib Hafeez, Elizabeth Eoff, Jeanne Wei, Gohar Azhar, Daniel Kam Yin Chan
pmc-11507427.description: Background/Objectives: This retrospective study focused on the role of Dopamine Transporter (DAT) scans in diagnosing Parkinson’s Disease (PD) in older adults with cognitive impairment (CI). Methods: We retrospectively analyzed brain imaging of 6483 individuals aged 60 and above with CI. Among these, 297 underwent a DAT scan, with 189 testing positive and 89 starting dopamine therapy.

pmc-12620620.title: Evaluating the Content Validity of the Modified Neuropathy Total Symptom Score-6 Self-Administered (mNTSS-6-SA) in a Painful Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathy Population
pmc-12620620.creator: Heather Gerould, Rikki Mangrum, Rebecca L Robinson, Karolina Schantz, Alexandra Bryant, Laure Delbecque, Benjamin Behrend, Karen L Price, Virginia L Stauffer, Ekin Seçinti
pmc-12620620.description: IntroductionPeople with diabetes often develop painful diabetic peripheral neuropathy (pDPN). Symptoms of pDPN vary and often lead to impairments in basic daily activities and negative impacts on quality of life. The Neuropathy Total Symptom Score-6 (NTSS-6) assesses the frequency and intensity of six neuropathic sensory symptoms.

pmc-13003596.title: Human-animal bonds: first cross-sectional study in laboratory animal care professionals in Argentina
pmc-13003596.creator: Gisela Ariana Marcoppido, Juan Santiago Guidobono, Marcos Trangoni, María Aluminé Mattana, Agustina Resasco, Silvina Laura Diaz
pmc-13003596.description: Working with laboratory animals can bring satisfaction but may also result in workplace stress. The established bonds between laboratory animals and their caretakers can make a person feel physically, mentally or emotionally uncomfortable. This phenomenon has been described as Compassion Fatigue (CF), a combination of burnout (BO) and secondary traumatic stress (STS).

pmc-13007673.title: Healthcare Providers’ Perception of Implementing the Bedside Exercises for Hospital Fitness (BE-FIT) Patient-Led Rehabilitation Program for Older Patients: A Qualitative Descriptive Study
pmc-13007673.creator: Sadaf Murad-Kassam, Beate C Sydora, Rachel G Khadaroo, Jude A Spiers
pmc-13007673.description: BackgroundDelayed mobilization in older surgery patients is a major risk factor for postoperative complications, including functional decline, prolonged hospital stays, and a higher risk of hospital readmission. Although postoperative mobilization is a foundational nursing intervention, it is not consistently performed due to competing demands such as staffing shortages and high patient acuity.

pmc-13069004.title: Zosteriform Lichen Planus
pmc-13069004.creator: Sunil Jaiswal, Shraddha Uprety, Pratichya Thapa, Aditi Joshi, Prakriti Lamichhane
pmc-13069004.description: Zosteriform Lichen Planus is a rare clinical variant that can mimic herpes zoster or other dermatomal eruptions. Dermoscopy can serve as a valuable, noninvasive tool for early and accurate diagnosis. Clinicians should be aware of this pattern of the disease to avoid misdiagnosis and ensure appropriate management.

pmc-13335934.title: Versatile DNA‐Functionalized Biohybrid Hydrogel Platforms for Electrothermally Activated On‐Demand Payload Release
pmc-13335934.creator: Mengqiu Sun, Zhenshuai Tang, Jia Zhang, Rui Song, Wei Luo, Juan Huang, Jincheng Zeng, Zhen He, Hao Zhang
pmc-13335934.description: Current drug delivery systems struggle to achieve precise control, rapid response, and high biocompatibility. Addressing these challenges, we developed an electrothermally responsive biohybrid hydrogel incorporating DNA‐functionalized nanostructures for on‐demand payload release. Unlike conventional platforms relying on passive diffusion or biochemical triggers, our system utilizes electrical stimulation to produce localized heating that simultaneously alters DNA conformation and hydrogel structure.

pmc-13401653.title: Suspected chronic eosinophilic leukemia in a cat treated with toceranib
pmc-13401653.creator: Cristian Mastrangelo, Andrea Siegel, Ariel Carruth, Nicole Leibman
pmc-13401653.description: Case summaryA 16-year-old, spayed female domestic shorthair cat was referred to the Schwarzman Animal Medical Center for evaluation of chronic, progressive eosinophilia accompanied by vomiting and weight loss despite normal appetite. Blood smear evaluation revealed immature eosinophils with dysplastic features and occasional giant forms. Abdominal ultrasound identified small-intestinal thickening, a hepatopathy and splenomegaly.

pmc-13441323.title: Contact Sensitisation Trends in Slovenian Children and Adolescents: A Retrospective Single‐Centre Study
pmc-13441323.creator: Mateja Starbek Zorko, Tomaž Lunder, Thomas Peric
pmc-13441323.description: BackgroundExisting data on contact sensitisation prevalence among children and adolescents is limited, especially regarding comparisons of specific allergens over extended timeframes. The objective of this study was to identify the most common allergens and to evaluate shifts in contact sensitisation trends.MethodsWe retrospectively evaluated patch test data of 1052 children and adolescents referred to a single tertiary medical centre.
